newsitem.title: USA: Clinton hails Jagan as "champion of the poor".
newsitem.headline: Clinton hails Jagan as "champion of the poor".

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton hailed Guyana's late President Cheddi Jagan, who died on Thursday, as a "champion of the poor."
"On behalf of the American people, I extend my deepest sympathies to the Jagan family and the people of Guyana," Clinton said in a written statement.
Jagan died early in the day at Walter Reed Army hospital, where he had undergone heart surgery to clear a blocked artery after being flown to the United States on Feb. 15.
Clinton said he learned of Jagan's death with "deep regret". He said he had met him at the Miami "Summit of the Americas" in December 1994.
"President Jagan was a champion of the poor who devoted himself to alleviating poverty in his country and throughout the Caribbean," he said.
He called Jagan a respected statesman "in our hemisphere of democracies."
